description: One published recipe whole: its prompt (sections in tags such as <direction> and <music>), what the reader brings (`inputs`: a video, a logo...), the template and model it was made with, its video, and its techniques (id, name, kind) whose standalone code get_technique gives. Use the prompt as a starting point for a similar video in Motion Fab or with your own tools.

id.description: A recipe id or slug from search_recipes.

lang.description: The language of the texts; default en.

name: get_recipe
